    if hv_mask is None:
        hv_mask = adata.var["highly_variable"].values if "highly_variable" in adata.var.columns else np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)

    # Prior-preserve genes: weight>=0.5 OR present in any set
    var_syms_upper = adata.var["symbol_clean"].astype(str).str.upper().str.strip()
    symbol_to_weight_map = priors.get("symbol_to_weight", {})
    prior_preserve_by_weight = np.array([float(symbol_to_weight_map.get(s, 0.0)) >= 0.5 for s in var_syms_upper.values], dtype=bool)
    prior_preserve_by_set = np.array([s in priors.get("symbols_in_sets", set()) for s in var_syms_upper.values], dtype=bool)
    prior_preserve = prior_preserve_by_weight | prior_preserve_by_set

    # Determine dispersion/variance ranking to add genes up to cap
    if "dispersions_norm" in adata.var.columns and adata.var["dispersions_norm"].notna().any():
        dispersion = adata.var["dispersions_norm"].fillna(0.0).values
    elif "variances_norm" in adata.var.columns and adata.var["variances_norm"].notna().any():
        dispersion = adata.var["variances_norm"].fillna(0.0).values
    else:
        # compute variance on log1p layer
        X_log = adata.layers["log1p"]
        if sparse.issparse(X_log):
            X_dense = X_log.A
        else:
            X_dense = np.asarray(X_log)
        dispersion = np.var(X_dense, axis=0)

    selected = hv_mask | prior_preserve
    cap = 6000
    current_idx = np.where(selected)[0].tolist()
    # If selected exceeds cap, down-select prioritizing prior weights and dispersion
    if len(current_idx) > cap:
        weights = np.array([float(symbol_to_weight_map.get(s, 0.0)) for s in var_syms_upper.values], dtype=float)
        in_set = prior_preserve_by_set.astype(float)
        hv_val = hv_mask.astype(float)
        score = weights + 0.5 * in_set + 0.1 * hv_val
        # break ties by dispersion
        rank_score = score * 1.0 + (dispersion / (dispersion.max() + 1e-8)) * 0.1
        top_idx = np.argsort(-rank_score)[:cap]
        selected = np.zeros(adata.n_vars, dtype=bool)
        selected[top_idx] = True
    else:
        # If under cap, add top-dispersion genes not yet included
        if len(current_idx) < cap:
            not_sel = np.where(~selected)[0]
            add_k = min(cap - len(current_idx), len(not_sel))
            if add_k > 0:
                add_idx = not_sel[np.argsort(-dispersion[not_sel])[:add_k]]
                selected[add_idx] = True

    # Subset to final genes
    adata = adata[:, selected].copy()

    # Layers are already subset by AnnData; no additional slicing needed

    # Optional regression out covariates on log1p (store corrected layer)
    # Prepare X as log1p before regression
    if sparse.issparse(adata.layers["log1p"]):

    else:

    for col in ["nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"]:

    adata.obs["percent.mt"] = adata.obs["percent.mt"].astype(float).fillna(0.0)
    sc.pp.regress_out(adata, keys=["nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"])
    adata.layers["log1p_regressed"] = adata.X.copy()

    adata.layers["scaled"] = adata.X.copy()
    # Ensure float32 dtypes

    for ln in ["counts", "log1p", "log1p_regressed", "scaled"]:

            else:

    # Splitting: stratified by domain
    if "domain" in adata.obs.columns:

    elif "dataset" in adata.obs.columns:

    else:

        adata.obs["domain"] = "all"
    rng = np.random.RandomState(SEED)
    splits = batch_stratified_split(dom, rng, train_frac=0.8, val_frac=0.1)
    adata.obs["split"] = splits

    # Keep essential obs columns for downstream
    for col in ["domain", "protocol", "dataset", "cell_type"]:
        if col not in adata.obs.columns:
            adata.obs[col] = pd.Categorical(["unknown"] * adata.n_obs) if col in ["domain", "protocol", "dataset"] else ["unknown"] * adata.n_obs

    # Create split-specific AnnData and save
    split_to_path = {"train": PREPROCESS_TRAIN, "val": PREPROCESS_VAL, "test": PREPROCESS_TEST}
    saved_shapes = {}
    for sp, path in split_to_path.items():
        idx = np.where(adata.obs["split"].values == sp)[0]
        ad_sp = adata[idx].copy()
        # Ensure layers dtypes and X dtype float32
        ad_sp.X = np.asarray(ad_sp.X, dtype=np.float32)
        for ln in ["counts", "log1p", "log1p_regressed", "scaled"]:
            if ln in ad_sp.layers:
                L = ad_sp.layers[ln]
                ad_sp.layers[ln] = L.astype(np.float32) if not sparse.issparse(L) else L.astype(np.float32)
        ad_sp.write_h5ad(path)
        assert os.path.exists(path), f"Missing output file: {path}"
        # Reload and assert shape/dtype
        ad_check = sc.read_h5ad(path)
        assert ad_check.n_obs == len(idx), f"Split {sp} cells mismatch"
        assert ad_check.n_vars == adata.n_vars, f"Split {sp} genes mismatch"

def to_numpy(x):
    if sparse.issparse(x):
        return x.toarray()
    elif isinstance(x, np.ndarray):
        return x
    else:
        return np.array(x)

def align_priors_to_genes(
    gene_vocab_csv: str,
    set_incidence_npz: str,
    set_meta_csv: str,
    gene_adj_npz: str,
    gene_prior_weights_csv: str,
    adata_var_names: List[str]
) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, csr_matrix, pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    # Load priors
    gene_vocab = pd.read_csv(gene_vocab_csv)
    set_meta = pd.read_csv(set_meta_csv)
    S = sparse.load_npz(set_incidence_npz).tocsr()
    A = sparse.load_npz(gene_adj_npz).tocsr()
    gene_w = pd.read_csv(gene_prior_weights_csv)

    # Map adata genes to prior indices
    # Expect gene_vocab has columns: gene_index, symbol
    symbol_to_index = {str(sym): int(idx) for sym, idx in zip(gene_vocab["symbol"].astype(str).values, gene_vocab["gene_index"].astype(int).values)}
    cols = []
    keep_idx = []
    for i, g in enumerate(adata_var_names):
        if g in symbol_to_index:
            cols.append(symbol_to_index[g])
            keep_idx.append(i)
    keep_idx = np.array(keep_idx, dtype=int)

    # Subset/permute S and A to these columns (genes) in the same order as kept adata genes
    col_idx = np.array(cols, dtype=int)
    S_sub = S[:, col_idx]  # shape: n_sets x n_genes_sub
    A_sub = A[col_idx, :][:, col_idx]  # n_genes_sub x n_genes_sub

    # Gene prior weights aligned to kept adata genes
    weight_map = {str(sym): float(w) for sym, w in zip(gene_w["symbol"].astype(str).values, gene_w["weight"].astype(float).values)}
    gene_weights = np.array([weight_map.get(adata_var_names[i], 1.0) for i in keep_idx], dtype=np.float32)

    # Return S as dense for model weight init; create also a marker mask
    S_dense = S_sub.astype(np.float32).toarray()
    is_marker = np.zeros(S_dense.shape[0], dtype=bool)
    if "source" in set_meta.columns:
        is_marker |= set_meta["source"].astype(str).str.contains("CellMarker", case=False, na=False).values
    if "category" in set_meta.columns:
        is_marker |= set_meta["category"].astype(str).str.contains("marker", case=False, na=False).values

    return S_dense, is_marker, A_sub, set_meta, gene_weights, keep_idx


class MaskedGeneSetLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, S_init: np.ndarray, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        # S_init: n_sets x n_genes
        S_tensor = torch.tensor(S_init, dtype=torch.float32)
        self.n_sets, self.n_genes = S_tensor.shape
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(S_tensor.clone())
        self.register_buffer("mask", (S_tensor > 0).float())
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(self.n_sets, dtype=torch.float32))
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(self.n_sets)
        self._frozen = False

    def freeze_weights(self, frozen: bool = True):
        self._frozen = frozen
        self.weight.requires_grad_(not frozen)

    def effective_weight(self):
        return self.weight * self.mask

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, n_genes]
        W = self.effective_weight().t()  # [n_genes, n_sets]
        out = torch.matmul(x, W) + self.bias  # [B, n_sets]
        out = F.relu(out)
        out = self.ln(out)
        out = self.dropout(out)
        return out


class PathwayAutoencoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, S_init: np.ndarray, d_latent: int = 32, dropout: float = 0.1, d_marker: int = 16):
        super().__init__()
        self.gs = MaskedGeneSetLayer(S_init, dropout=dropout)
        n_sets = S_init.shape[0]
        self.enc1 = nn.Linear(n_sets, 512)
        self.enc2 = nn.Linear(512, 128)
        self.latent = nn.Linear(128, d_latent)

        self.dec1 = nn.Linear(d_latent, 128)
        self.dec2 = nn.Linear(128, 512)
        self.dec_sets = nn.Linear(512, n_sets)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(512)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(128)
        self.ln3 = nn.LayerNorm(512)
        self.n_sets = n_sets
        self.n_genes = S_init.shape[1]
        self.d_latent = d_latent
        self.d_marker = min(d_marker, d_latent)

    def freeze_gs(self, frozen: bool = True):
        self.gs.freeze_weights(frozen)

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, n_genes]
        set_act = self.gs(x)  # [B, n_sets]
        h = F.relu(self.enc1(set_act))
        h = self.ln1(h)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        h = F.relu(self.enc2(h))
        h = self.ln2(h)
        h = self.dropout(h)
        z = self.latent(h)

        d = F.relu(self.dec1(z))
        d = self.ln2(d)  # reuse shape-compatible ln2 (128)
        d = self.dropout(d)
        d = F.relu(self.dec2(d))
        d = self.ln3(d)
        d = self.dropout(d)
        set_recon = self.dec_sets(d)  # [B, n_sets]
        # Genes recon via tied weights
        W_eff = self.gs.effective_weight()  # [n_sets, n_genes]
        x_recon = torch.matmul(set_recon, W_eff)  # [B, n_genes]
        return x_recon, z, set_act, set_recon


def mse_recon(x, x_recon, gene_weights: torch.Tensor):
    # weighted MSE per gene
    # x, x_recon: [B, G]; gene_weights: [G]
    diff = (x_recon - x) ** 2
    w = gene_weights.view(1, -1)
    loss = (diff * w).mean()
    return loss


def prior_proximity_loss(model: PathwayAutoencoder, S_init_t: torch.Tensor):
    # L2 on differences over masked edges
    W_eff = model.gs.effective_weight()
    diff = (W_eff - S_init_t) * (S_init_t > 0).float()
    return (diff ** 2).mean()


def group_lasso_loss(model: PathwayAutoencoder, eps: float = 1e-8):
    # Group lasso on gene columns -> encourage sparsity of connections per gene
    W_eff = model.gs.effective_weight()  # [n_sets, n_genes]
    col_norms = torch.sqrt(torch.sum(W_eff ** 2, dim=0) + eps)  # [n_genes]
    return torch.sum(col_norms) / W_eff.shape[1]


def laplacian_loss(model: PathwayAutoencoder, L_sparse: torch.Tensor):
    # L is sparse [G, G]; Want trace(W L W^T) where W: [S, G]
    # Compute temp = L @ W^T -> [G, S]; then loss = sum((temp^T * W))
    W = model.gs.effective_weight()
    temp = torch.sparse.mm(L_sparse, W.t())  # [G, S]
    loss = torch.sum((temp.t()) * W)
    return loss / (W.shape[0] * W.shape[1])


def marker_anchoring_loss(z: torch.Tensor, set_act: torch.Tensor, marker_set_idx: torch.Tensor, d_marker: int):
    # Align first d_marker dims of z to selected marker set activations
    if marker_set_idx.numel() == 0 or d_marker == 0:
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=z.device)
    k = min(d_marker, marker_set_idx.numel())
    target = set_act[:, marker_set_idx[:k]]  # [B, k]
    z_mark = z[:, :k]
    # Normalize to unit variance
    target = (target - target.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)) / (target.std(dim=0, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    z_mark = (z_mark - z_mark.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)) / (z_mark.std(dim=0, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    return F.mse_loss(z_mark, target)


def mmd_rbf(x: torch.Tensor, y: torch.Tensor, gamma: float = None):
    # x: [n, d], y: [m, d]
    # RBF kernel MMD
    xx = torch.cdist(x, x, p=2) ** 2
    yy = torch.cdist(y, y, p=2) ** 2
    xy = torch.cdist(x, y, p=2) ** 2
    if gamma is None:
        # median heuristic on combined distances
        vals = torch.cat([xx.flatten(), yy.flatten(), xy.flatten()], dim=0)
        vals = vals[vals > 0]
        med = torch.median(vals)
        if torch.isinf(med) or torch.isnan(med) or med.item() == 0.0:
            med = torch.tensor(1.0, device=x.device)
        gamma = 1.0 / (2.0 * med)
    Kxx = torch.exp(-gamma * xx)
    Kyy = torch.exp(-gamma * yy)
    Kxy = torch.exp(-gamma * xy)
    mmd = Kxx.mean() + Kyy.mean() - 2 * Kxy.mean()
    return mmd


def mmd_multigroup(z: torch.Tensor, batch_ids: torch.Tensor):
    # Average MMD between each group's samples and the pooled distribution
    unique = torch.unique(batch_ids)
    if unique.numel() <= 1:
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=z.device)
    losses = []
    for b in unique:
        zb = z[batch_ids == b]
        zu = z  # pooled
        if zb.shape[0] < 2:
            continue
        losses.append(mmd_rbf(zb, zu))
    if len(losses) == 0:
        return torch.tensor(0.0, device=z.device)
    return torch.stack(losses).mean()


def nuisance_corr_loss(z: torch.Tensor, covariates: torch.Tensor):
    # z: [B, d], covariates: [B, c] (e.g., percent.mt, nCount_RNA)
    zc = z - z.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
    zc = zc / (zc.std(dim=0, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    cc = covariates - covariates.mean(dim=0, keepdim=True)
    cc = cc / (cc.std(dim=0, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
    # Correlation per dim with each cov
    corr = torch.matmul(zc.t(), cc) / z.shape[0]  # [d, c]
    return torch.mean(corr ** 2)


class TensorDatasetSC(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    def __init__(self, X: np.ndarray, batch_ids: np.ndarray, covariates: np.ndarray):
        self.X = X.astype(np.float32, copy=False)
        self.batch_ids = batch_ids.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
        self.covariates = covariates.astype(np.float32, copy=False)

    def __len__(self):
        return self.X.shape[0]

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return (
            torch.from_numpy(self.X[idx]),
            torch.tensor(self.batch_ids[idx], dtype=torch.long),
            torch.from_numpy(self.covariates[idx]),
        )


def build_laplacian_sparse(A_csr: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    # A should be row-normalized, but compute Laplacian L = D - A (symmetric)
    if not sparse.isspmatrix_csr(A_csr):
        A_csr = A_csr.tocsr()
    # Symmetrize
    A_sym = (A_csr + A_csr.T) * 0.5
    degrees = np.array(A_sym.sum(axis=1)).flatten()
    D = sparse.diags(degrees)
    L = D - A_sym
    return L.tocsr()


def to_torch_sparse(mat: csr_matrix, device=None) -> torch.Tensor:
    coo = mat.tocoo()
    indices = np.vstack((coo.row, coo.col))
    indices = torch.tensor(indices, dtype=torch.long)
    values = torch.tensor(coo.data, dtype=torch.float32)
    shape = torch.Size(coo.shape)
    ts = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(indices, values, shape)
    return ts.coalesce().to(device if device is not None else "cpu")


def prepare_data_and_priors():
    # Load preprocessed splits
    ad_train = load_h5ad(PREPROCESS_TRAIN_MOD1)
    ad_val = load_h5ad(PREPROCESS_VAL_MOD1)
    ad_test = load_h5ad(PREPROCESS_TEST_MOD1)

    # Determine gene list intersection with priors
    S_init, is_marker, A_sub, set_meta, gene_weights, keep_idx = align_priors_to_genes(
        os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "gene_vocab.csv"),
        os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "set_incidence.npz"),
        os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "set_meta.csv"),
        os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "gene_gene_adj.npz"),
        os.path.join(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR, "gene_prior_weights.csv"),
        ad_train.var_names.tolist(),
    )
    # Align adata matrices to genes present in priors, in the same order used to build S_init
    def X_from_adata(adx: ad.AnnData, keep_columns: np.ndarray):
        X = adx.X
        X = to_numpy(X).astype(np.float32, copy=False)
        if keep_columns is not None and keep_columns.size > 0:
            X = X[:, keep_columns]
        return X

    X_train = X_from_adata(ad_train, keep_idx)
    X_val = X_from_adata(ad_val, keep_idx)
    X_test = X_from_adata(ad_test, keep_idx)

    # Subset obs
    def get_col_safe(obs: pd.DataFrame, name: str, fallback: str = None):
        if name in obs.columns:
            return obs[name].astype(str).values
        return np.array([fallback] * obs.shape[0], dtype=str)

    # Batches: use domain if present else dataset
    batch_train = get_col_safe(ad_train.obs, "domain", None)
    if batch_train[0] is None:
        batch_train = get_col_safe(ad_train.obs, "dataset", "batch0")
    batch_val = get_col_safe(ad_val.obs, "domain", None)
    if batch_val[0] is None:
        batch_val = get_col_safe(ad_val.obs, "dataset", "batch0")
    batch_test = get_col_safe(ad_test.obs, "domain", None)
    if batch_test[0] is None:
        batch_test = get_col_safe(ad_test.obs, "dataset", "batch0")

    # Covariates: percent.mt and nCount_RNA
    def cov_from_obs(obs: pd.DataFrame):
        pmt = obs["percent.mt"].astype(float).values if "percent.mt" in obs.columns else np.zeros(obs.shape[0], dtype=float)
        ncount = obs["nCount_RNA"].astype(float).values if "nCount_RNA" in obs.columns else np.zeros(obs.shape[0], dtype=float)
        cov = np.stack([pmt, ncount], axis=1).astype(np.float32)
        return cov

    cov_train = cov_from_obs(ad_train.obs)
    cov_val = cov_from_obs(ad_val.obs)
    cov_test = cov_from_obs(ad_test.obs)

    # Build batch label encoder across all splits
    all_batches = np.concatenate([batch_train, batch_val, batch_test], axis=0)
    uniq_batches = {b: i for i, b in enumerate(sorted(np.unique(all_batches)))}
    b_train = np.array([uniq_batches[b] for b in batch_train], dtype=np.int64)
    b_val = np.array([uniq_batches[b] for b in batch_val], dtype=np.int64)
    b_test = np.array([uniq_batches[b] for b in batch_test], dtype=np.int64)

    # Marker set indices
    marker_idx = np.where(is_marker)[0]
    # Order marker sets by weight (if present) or size descending; fallback to current order
    if "weight" in set_meta.columns and marker_idx.size > 0:
        marker_idx = marker_idx[np.argsort(-set_meta.loc[marker_idx, "weight"].values)]
    elif "size" in set_meta.columns and marker_idx.size > 0:
        marker_idx = marker_idx[np.argsort(-set_meta.loc[marker_idx, "size"].values)]

    # Collect metadata for downstream
    meta = {
        "train": {
            "cell_ids": ad_train.obs_names.tolist(),
            "cell_type": get_col_safe(ad_train.obs, "cell_type", "unknown"),
            "batch": batch_train.tolist(),
        },
        "val": {
            "cell_ids": ad_val.obs_names.tolist(),
            "cell_type": get_col_safe(ad_val.obs, "cell_type", "unknown"),
            "batch": batch_val.tolist(),
        },
        "test": {
            "cell_ids": ad_test.obs_names.tolist(),
            "cell_type": get_col_safe(ad_test.obs, "cell_type", "unknown"),
            "batch": batch_test.tolist(),
        },
    }

    # Build Laplacian
    L = build_laplacian_sparse(A_sub)

    return (X_train, X_val, X_test, b_train, b_val, b_test, cov_train, cov_val, cov_test,
            S_init, marker_idx, L, gene_weights, meta, set_meta)


def choose_k_by_silhouette(Z: np.ndarray, candidate_k: List[int]) -> int:
    # Candidate ks filtered by n_samples
    n = Z.shape[0]
    ks = [k for k in candidate_k if 2 < k < n]
    if len(ks) == 0:
        return min(max(2, n // 50), 10)
    best_k = ks[0]
    best_score = -1.0
    for k in ks:
        km = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
        labels = km.fit_predict(Z)
        if len(np.unique(labels)) < 2:
            continue
        try:
            s = silhouette_score(Z, labels, metric="cosine")
        except Exception:
            s = -1.0
        if s > best_score:
            best_score = s
            best_k = k
    return best_k


def train_model():
    set_seed(42)
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

    (X_train, X_val, X_test, b_train, b_val, b_test, cov_train, cov_val, cov_test,
     S_init, marker_idx, L, gene_weights, meta, set_meta) = prepare_data_and_priors()

    n_genes = X_train.shape[1]
    n_sets = S_init.shape[0]
    d_latent = 32
    d_marker = min(16, len(marker_idx))

    model = PathwayAutoencoder(S_init=S_init, d_latent=d_latent, dropout=0.1, d_marker=d_marker).to(device)
    model.freeze_gs(True)  # warm start

    # Prepare losses inputs
    gene_w_t = torch.tensor(gene_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    S_init_t = torch.tensor(S_init, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    L_t = to_torch_sparse(L, device=device)

    # Datasets and loaders
    batch_size = 512
    ds_train = TensorDatasetSC(X_train, b_train, cov_train)
    ds_val = TensorDatasetSC(X_val, b_val, cov_val)
    dl_train = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds_train, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=True, drop_last=False)
    dl_val = torch.utils.data.DataLoader(ds_val, batch_size=batch_size, shuffle=False, drop_last=False)

    # Optimizer and scheduler
    opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4)
    # Compatibility with older torch versions that don't accept 'verbose'
    try:
        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(opt, mode="min", patience=10, factor=0.5, verbose=False)
    except TypeError:
        scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(opt, mode="min", patience=10, factor=0.5)

    # Loss weights
    lam_recon = 1.0
    lam_prior = 1.0
    lam_group = 1e-3
    lam_lap = 1e-2
    lam_marker = 0.5 if d_marker > 0 else 0.0
    lam_mmd = 0.2
    lam_nuis = 0.1
    lam_dec = 0.5

    # Training schedule
    epochs = 200
    warmup_end = 30
    finetune_end = 60

    # DEC placeholders
    use_dec = False
    dec_centers = None
    q_target = None
    k_dec = None

    best_val = float("inf")
    best_state = None
    best_epoch = -1
    patience = 20
    num_bad = 0

    marker_idx_t = torch.tensor(marker_idx, dtype=torch.long, device=device) if d_marker > 0 else torch.tensor([], dtype=torch.long, device=device)

    logs = []
    start_time = time.time()

    for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        if epoch == warmup_end + 1:
            # Unfreeze gene-set layer
            model.freeze_gs(False)

        if epoch <= finetune_end:
            lam_mmd_eff = lam_mmd * 0.5
            lam_nuis_eff = lam_nuis * 0.5
        else:
            # linearly ramp to full by epoch 100
            t = min(max(epoch - finetune_end, 0), 40) / 40.0
            lam_mmd_eff = lam_mmd * (0.5 + 0.5 * t)
            lam_nuis_eff = lam_nuis

        if epoch == finetune_end + 1:
            use_dec = True
            # Build latent on train set to choose k and initialize centers
            model.eval()
            with torch.no_grad():
                Z_tr = []
                for xb, _, _ in dl_train:
                    xb = xb.to(device)
                    _, z, _, _ = model(xb)
                    Z_tr.append(z.detach().cpu().numpy())
                Z_tr = np.vstack(Z_tr)
                # Standardize for kmeans
                scaler = StandardScaler(with_mean=True, with_std=True)
                Zs = scaler.fit_transform(Z_tr)
                k_dec = choose_k_by_silhouette(Zs, candidate_k=[5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20])
                km = KMeans(n_clusters=k_dec, random_state=42, n_init=10).fit(Zs)
                centers = km.cluster_centers_.astype(np.float32)
                # Map centers back to original scale
                # Approximate inverse scaling: multiply by std and add mean
                if hasattr(scaler, "scale_") and hasattr(scaler, "mean_"):
                    centers = centers * scaler.scale_ + scaler.mean_
                dec_centers = torch.tensor(centers, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)

        # For DEC target refresh every 5 epochs
        if use_dec and (epoch - finetune_end) % 5 == 1:

            with torch.no_grad():
                # compute q on train data to build target p
                Z_tr = []
                for xb, _, _ in dl_train:
                    xb = xb.to(device)
                    _, z, _, _ = model(xb)
                    Z_tr.append(z)
                Z_tr = torch.cat(Z_tr, dim=0)  # [N, d]
                # Student t-distribution based soft assignments
                # q_ij = (1 + ||z_i - c_j||^2)^-1 / normalize
                d2 = torch.cdist(Z_tr, dec_centers, p=2) ** 2  # [N, k]
                q = 1.0 / (1.0 + d2)
                q = q / q.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
                # target distribution p
                f = q.sum(dim=0, keepdim=True)  # [1, k]
                p = (q ** 2) / (f + 1e-9)
                p = p / p.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
                q_target = p.detach()

        # Train epoch
        total_loss = 0.0
        recon_loss_epoch = 0.0
        prior_loss_epoch = 0.0
        group_loss_epoch = 0.0
        lap_loss_epoch = 0.0
        marker_loss_epoch = 0.0
        mmd_loss_epoch = 0.0
        nuis_loss_epoch = 0.0
        dec_loss_epoch = 0.0

        for i, (xb, b, cov) in enumerate(dl_train):
            xb = xb.to(device)
            b = b.to(device)
            cov = cov.to(device)
            x_recon, z, set_act, _ = model(xb)

            loss = lam_recon * mse_recon(xb, x_recon, gene_w_t)

            if epoch > warmup_end:
                lp = prior_proximity_loss(model, S_init_t)
                lg = group_lasso_loss(model)
                ll = laplacian_loss(model, L_t)
                loss = loss + lam_prior * lp + lam_group * lg + lam_lap * ll
                prior_loss_epoch += lp.item()
                group_loss_epoch += lg.item()
                lap_loss_epoch += ll.item()

                if d_marker > 0 and marker_idx_t.numel() > 0:
                    lmark = marker_anchoring_loss(z, set_act, marker_idx_t, model.d_marker)
                    loss = loss + lam_marker * lmark
                    marker_loss_epoch += lmark.item()

                lmmd = mmd_multigroup(z, b)
                loss = loss + lam_mmd_eff * lmmd
                mmd_loss_epoch += lmmd.item()

                lnuis = nuisance_corr_loss(z, cov)
                loss = loss + lam_nuis_eff * lnuis
                nuis_loss_epoch += lnuis.item()

                if use_dec and q_target is not None:
                    # Compute q for current batch; need index mapping to target rows: approximate by cycling or recompute small-batch p
                    d2 = torch.cdist(z, dec_centers, p=2) ** 2
                    q = 1.0 / (1.0 + d2)
                    q = q / q.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
                    # Compute local target p_batch using current q (as in DEC online variant)
                    f = q.sum(dim=0, keepdim=True)
                    p_batch = (q ** 2) / (f + 1e-9)
                    p_batch = p_batch / p_batch.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True)
                    ldec = F.kl_div(q.log(), p_batch, reduction="batchmean")
                    loss = loss + lam_dec * ldec
                    dec_loss_epoch += ldec.item()

            opt.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=5.0)
            opt.step()

            total_loss += loss.item()
            recon_loss_epoch += (lam_recon * mse_recon(xb, x_recon, gene_w_t)).item()

        # Validation
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            val_loss = 0.0
            val_mmd = 0.0
            val_marker = 0.0
            for xb, b, cov in dl_val:
                xb = xb.to(device)
                b = b.to(device)
                cov = cov.to(device)
                x_recon, z, set_act, _ = model(xb)
                l = lam_recon * mse_recon(xb, x_recon, gene_w_t)
                if epoch > warmup_end:
                    l = l + lam_mmd_eff * mmd_multigroup(z, b)
                    if d_marker > 0 and marker_idx_t.numel() > 0:
                        l = l + lam_marker * marker_anchoring_loss(z, set_act, marker_idx_t, model.d_marker)
                val_loss += l.item()
            val_loss = val_loss / max(1, len(dl_val))

        scheduler.step(val_loss)

        log = {
            "epoch": epoch,
            "train_loss": total_loss / max(1, len(dl_train)),
            "recon_loss": recon_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)),
            "prior_loss": prior_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "group_loss": group_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "lap_loss": lap_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "marker_loss": marker_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "mmd_loss": mmd_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "nuis_loss": nuis_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if epoch > warmup_end else 0.0,
            "dec_loss": dec_loss_epoch / max(1, len(dl_train)) if (epoch > finetune_end and use_dec) else 0.0,
            "val_objective": val_loss,
            "lr": opt.param_groups[0]["lr"],
        }
        logs.append(log)

        # Early stopping
        if val_loss < best_val - 1e-6:
            best_val = val_loss
            best_state = {k: v.detach().cpu() for k, v in model.state_dict().items()}
            best_epoch = epoch
            num_bad = 0
        else:
            num_bad += 1

        if epoch > finetune_end and num_bad >= patience:
            break

    if best_state is not None:
        model.load_state_dict(best_state)
    train_time = time.time() - start_time

    # Save best model
    ensure_dir(BEST_MODEL)
    torch.save(model.state_dict(), BEST_MODEL)
    assert os.path.exists(BEST_MODEL) and os.path.getsize(BEST_MODEL) > 0

    # Build embeddings for all splits
    def embed_split(X: np.ndarray) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        zs = []
        sa = []
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            for i in range(0, X.shape[0], 1024):
                xb = torch.tensor(X[i:i+1024], dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
                _, z, set_act, _ = model(xb)
                zs.append(z.detach().cpu().numpy())
                sa.append(set_act.detach().cpu().numpy())
        return np.vstack(zs).astype(np.float32), np.vstack(sa).astype(np.float32)

    ensure_dir(EMBEDDING)
    np.save(EMBEDDING, Z_all.astype(np.float32))
    assert os.path.exists(EMBEDDING)
    arr = np.load(EMBEDDING)
    assert arr.shape == Z_all.shape and arr.dtype == np.float32

    cell_ids = meta["train"]["cell_ids"] + meta["val"]["cell_ids"] + meta["test"]["cell_ids"]

    for col in ["cell_id", "split", "row_index", "cell_type", "batch"]:

    assert dfm.shape[0] == Z_all.shape[0]

    # Per-cluster: size, domain/protocol composition, top 10 enriched sets (by mean diff on set activity), top 20 DEGs (Wilcoxon), mean latent vector
    # Build combined set activities and gene matrix for DE
    X_all = np.vstack([X_train, X_val, X_test]).astype(np.float32)

    for c in sorted(np.unique(clusters)):

                marker_genes.add(g)
        if r.category == "marker":
            min_sz = 5
        else:
            min_sz = 10
        if len(member) < min_sz:
            continue
        final_sets.append(SetRecord(name=r.name, source=r.source, category=r.category, genes=set(member)))

    for set_id, r in enumerate(final_sets):
        sz = len(r.genes)
        weight = 1.0 / np.sqrt(sz) if sz > 0 else 0.0
        # Row-normalization target: sum to 1 => per-entry value = 1/sz
        val = 1.0 / sz
        for g in r.genes:
            rows.append(set_id)
            cols.append(g)
            data.append(val)
            gene_set_count[g] += 1
        meta_rows.append({
            "set_id": set_id,
            "name": r.name,
            "source": r.source,
            "category": r.category,
            "size": sz,
            "weight": weight
        })
        nsets_kept += 1

    if len(rows) == 0:
        S = csr_matrix((0, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    else:
        S = csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                       shape=(nsets_kept, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_rows, columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    return S, meta_df, gene_set_count, marker_genes


def compute_jaccard_topk(B_bin: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    # B_bin: (n_sets x n_genes) binary CSR matrix
    n_sets, n_genes = B_bin.shape
    if n_sets == 0 or n_genes == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    # Compute co-membership counts C = B^T * B (n_genes x n_genes)
    C = (B_bin.T).dot(B_bin).tocsr()
    deg = np.asarray(B_bin.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)  # number of sets per gene

    # Zero out diagonal by subtracting deg on diagonal
    diag_idx = np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int32)
    C = C.tolil(copy=True)
    C[diag_idx, diag_idx] = 0
    C = C.tocsr()

    indptr = C.indptr
    indices = C.indices
    data = C.data

    rows_out = []
    cols_out = []
    vals_out = []

    for i in range(n_genes):
        start = indptr[i]
        end = indptr[i + 1]
        js = indices[start:end]
        co = data[start:end].astype(np.float32)
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        denom = deg[i] + deg[js] - co
        # Avoid divide by zero
        denom = np.where(denom <= 0, 1.0, denom)
        jacc = co / denom
        # Select top-k neighbors
        if jacc.size > k:
            topk_idx = np.argpartition(-jacc, k)[:k]
            js_top = js[topk_idx]
            jacc_top = jacc[topk_idx]
            # sort by value descending for stability
            order = np.argsort(-jacc_top)
            js_top = js_top[order]
            jacc_top = jacc_top[order]
        else:
            js_top = js
            jacc_top = jacc
        # Store
        rows_out.extend([i] * len(js_top))
        cols_out.extend(js_top.tolist())
        vals_out.extend(jacc_top.tolist())

    if len(rows_out) == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    A = csr_matrix((np.array(vals_out, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows_out, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols_out, dtype=np.int32))),
                   shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
    return A


def symmetrize_max(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    return (A.maximum(A.T)).tocsr()


def row_normalize_csr(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr(copy=True)
    row_sums = np.asarray(A.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    nz = row_sums > 0
    inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz]
    Dinv = sparse.diags(inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    return Dinv.dot(A).astype(np.float32)


def keep_topk_per_row(A: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr()
    n_rows = A.shape[0]
    rows = []
    cols = []
    data = []
    for i in range(n_rows):
        start = A.indptr[i]
        end = A.indptr[i + 1]
        js = A.indices[start:end]
        vals = A.data[start:end]
        # Remove self-loop if present
        mask = js != i
        js = js[mask]
        vals = vals[mask]
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        if js.size > k:
            idx = np.argpartition(-vals, k)[:k]
            js_k = js[idx]
            vals_k = vals[idx]
            order = np.argsort(-vals_k)
            js_k = js_k[order]
            vals_k = vals_k[order]
        else:
            js_k = js
            vals_k = vals
        rows.extend([i] * js_k.size)
        cols.extend(js_k.tolist())
        data.extend(vals_k.tolist())
    if len(rows) == 0:
        return csr_matrix(A.shape, dtype=np.float32)
    return csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                      shape=A.shape, dtype=np.float32)


def main():

            if t.shape[0] > 0:
                any_pseudo = any(("pseudogene" in str(tt).lower()) for tt in t.values)
                if any_pseudo:
                    banned.add(i)

    n_sets_tmp = tmp_S.shape[0]

        # Count small sets (<=50) participation

    gene_vocab_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "gene_raw": var_names,
        "symbol": mapped_symbols,
        "gene_index": np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int64),

    p = np.asarray(pvals, dtype=float)
    m = p.size
    order = np.argsort(p)
    ranked_p = p[order]
    q = ranked_p * m / (np.arange(m) + 1)
    q = np.minimum.accumulate(q[::-1])[::-1]
    q[q > 1] = 1
    out = np.empty_like(q)

    sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(ad_deg, groupby='predicted_cluster', method='wilcoxon', n_genes=min(200, ad_deg.n_vars))
    deg_res = sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(ad_deg, group=None)  # returns combined df
    # Collect top 20 DEGs per cluster with positive logfoldchanges
    top_degs_per_cluster = {}
    for clust in sorted(ad_deg.obs['predicted_cluster'].cat.categories, key=lambda x: str(x)):
        sub = deg_res[deg_res['group'] == clust].copy()
        if 'logfoldchanges' in sub.columns:
            sub = sub[sub['logfoldchanges'] > 0]
        sub = sub.sort_values(['pvals_adj', 'scores'], ascending=[True, False])
        top_genes = sub['names'].astype(str).head(20).tolist()
        top_degs_per_cluster[str(clust)] = top_genes

    # Load prior sets to compute set activities and marker overlap
    set_incidence_path = os.path.join(prior_output_dir, "set_incidence.npz")
    set_meta_path = os.path.join(prior_output_dir, "set_meta.csv")
    gene_vocab_path = os.path.join(prior_output_dir, "gene_vocab.csv")
    S_full = load_sparse_csr(set_incidence_path)  # n_sets x n_genes
    set_meta = pd.read_csv(set_meta_path)
    gene_vocab = pd.read_csv(gene_vocab_path)
    assert sp.isspmatrix_csr(S_full) and S_full.shape[0] == set_meta.shape[0]
    assert 'symbol' in gene_vocab.columns

    # Align S to ad_deg.var_names
    vocab_symbols = gene_vocab['symbol'].astype(str).values
    symbol_to_idx = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(vocab_symbols)}
    keep_gene_idx = []
    for g in ad_deg.var_names:
        if g in symbol_to_idx:
            keep_gene_idx.append(symbol_to_idx[g])
        else:
            keep_gene_idx.append(None)
    # Build mapping for columns present
    present_mask = np.array([i is not None for i in keep_gene_idx])
    present_gene_indices = np.array([i for i in keep_gene_idx if i is not None], dtype=int)
    # If no genes overlap, raise
    assert present_gene_indices.size > 0, "No overlap between gene_vocab and adata var_names"
    # Reorder columns of S to match ad_deg.var_names order, dropping non-present
    # We create a new S_sub of shape (n_sets, n_present_genes_in_adata)
    S_sub = S_full[:, present_gene_indices]  # sets x present_genes
    # Now we need to map present genes back to ad_deg.var order
    # current columns correspond to order of present_gene_indices which is in the order of ad_deg.var_names filtered by presence
    # Build array of ad gene indices that are present
    ad_present_indices = np.where(present_mask)[0]
    # Create a permutation that maps from current order (filtered ad var order) to full ad var order positions
    # We'll build a sparse matrix with the same column order as ad_deg.var_names by placing zeros in non-present columns
    n_sets = S_sub.shape[0]
    n_ad_genes = ad_deg.n_vars
    # Expand S_sub into full gene space (sets x n_ad_genes)
    if S_sub.nnz == 0:
        raise AssertionError("Set incidence has no nonzero entries after alignment.")
    # Efficient expansion: create an empty CSR and fill columns at ad_present_indices
    S_sub_csc = S_sub.tocsc()
    data, indices, indptr = [], [], [0]
    for i in range(n_sets):
        col_idx = S_sub_csc.getrow(i).indices if hasattr(S_sub_csc, "getrow") else S_sub.getrow(i).indices
    # Simpler approach: build a sparse matrix of shape (n_sets, n_ad_genes) and assign columns
    S_aligned = sp.csr_matrix((n_sets, n_ad_genes), dtype=S_sub.dtype)
    # Assign in CSC for column assignment efficiency
    S_aligned = S_aligned.tocsc(copy=False)
    S_sub_csc = S_sub.tocsc(copy=False)
    S_aligned[:, ad_present_indices] = S_sub_csc
    S_aligned = S_aligned.tocsr(copy=False)

    # Compute per-cell set activity scores: X_log1p (cells x genes) dot S_aligned.T (genes x sets)
    X_log1p = ad_deg.X
    if sp.issparse(X_log1p):
        set_scores = X_log1p.dot(S_aligned.T)  # shape: cells x sets
        set_scores = set_scores.toarray()
    else:
        set_scores = np.dot(np.asarray(X_log1p), S_aligned.T.toarray())
    assert set_scores.shape[0] == ad_deg.n_obs and set_scores.shape[1] == n_sets

    # Per-cluster set enrichment via Wilcoxon rank-sum with BH-FDR
    cluster_labels = np.array(ad_deg.obs['predicted_cluster'].astype(str).values)
    unique_clusters = sorted(np.unique(cluster_labels), key=lambda x: str(x))
    # Precompute cluster indices
    cluster_indices = {c: np.where(cluster_labels == c)[0] for c in unique_clusters}
    not_cluster_indices = {c: np.where(cluster_labels != c)[0] for c in unique_clusters}

    # Prepare gene membership per set for marker overlap
    # Column symbols aligned to ad_deg.var_names
    ad_gene_symbols = ad_deg.var_names.to_numpy().astype(str)
    # For each set, get member genes (indices with nonzero in S_aligned row)
    set_members = []
    S_rows = S_aligned.tocsr()
    for i in range(n_sets):
        row = S_rows.getrow(i)
        cols = row.indices
        genes_i = set(ad_gene_symbols[cols].tolist())
        set_members.append(genes_i)

    # Marker sets indices
    marker_mask = np.array([(str(src).lower() == 'cellmarker') or (str(cat).lower() == 'marker')
                            for src, cat in zip(set_meta.get('source', ['']*n_sets),
                                                set_meta.get('category', ['']*n_sets))])
    marker_indices = np.where(marker_mask)[0].tolist()

    # Compute summaries per cluster
    summary = {}
    # Domain/protocol composition data
    domains = ad_deg.obs['domain'].astype(str).values if 'domain' in ad_deg.obs.columns else np.array(['NA']*ad_deg.n_obs)
    protocols = ad_deg.obs['protocol'].astype(str).values if 'protocol' in ad_deg.obs.columns else np.array(['NA']*ad_deg.n_obs)

    for c in unique_clusters:
        idx_in = cluster_indices[c]
        idx_out = not_cluster_indices[c]
        size_c = int(idx_in.size)

        # Domain/protocol composition
        dom_counts = pd.Series(domains[idx_in]).value_counts().to_dict()
        prot_counts = pd.Series(protocols[idx_in]).value_counts().to_dict()

        # Set enrichment stats
        pvals = []
        mean_diff = []
        for j in range(n_sets):
            in_vals = set_scores[idx_in, j]
            out_vals = set_scores[idx_out, j]
            # Use two-sided test; we'll filter by positive effect
            try:
                stat = mannwhitneyu(in_vals, out_vals, alternative='two-sided', method='auto')
                p = stat.pvalue
            except TypeError:
                # For older SciPy without 'method' kw
                p = mannwhitneyu(in_vals, out_vals, alternative='two-sided')[1]
            pvals.append(p)
            mean_diff.append(float(np.mean(in_vals) - np.mean(out_vals)))
        pvals = np.array(pvals, dtype=float)
        qvals = bh_fdr(pvals)
        mean_diff = np.array(mean_diff, dtype=float)
        # Select top 10 enriched (positive effect), sort by qval then effect size
        enriched_mask = mean_diff > 0
        idx_enriched = np.where(enriched_mask)[0]
        if idx_enriched.size == 0:
            # Fallback: take top 10 by mean_diff
            top_idx = np.argsort(-mean_diff)[:10]
        else:
            sort_ord = np.lexsort(( -mean_diff[idx_enriched], qvals[idx_enriched] ))
            top_idx = idx_enriched[sort_ord][:10]
        top_sets = []
        for j in top_idx:
            top_sets.append({
                'set_id': int(set_meta.iloc[j].get('set_id', j)) if 'set_id' in set_meta.columns else int(j),
                'name': str(set_meta.iloc[j].get('name', f'set_{j}')),
                'source': str(set_meta.iloc[j].get('source', 'NA')),
                'category': str(set_meta.iloc[j].get('category', 'NA')),
                'fdr': float(qvals[j]),
                'effect_size': float(mean_diff[j])
            })

        # DEGs
        top_degs = top_degs_per_cluster.get(str(c), [])

        # Marker overlap using top DEGs
        marker_overlaps = []
        deg_set = set(top_degs)
        if len(deg_set) > 0 and len(marker_indices) > 0:
            for j in marker_indices:
                genes_j = set_members[j]
                inter = deg_set & genes_j
                union = deg_set | genes_j
                if len(union) == 0:
                    jac = 0.0
                else:
                    jac = len(inter) / float(len(union))
                if len(inter) > 0:
                    marker_overlaps.append({
                        'set_id': int(set_meta.iloc[j].get('set_id', j)) if 'set_id' in set_meta.columns else int(j),
                        'name': str(set_meta.iloc[j].get('name', f'set_{j}')),
                        'jaccard': float(jac),
                        'overlap_genes': sorted(list(inter))
                    })
            # Top 5 by Jaccard
            marker_overlaps = sorted(marker_overlaps, key=lambda x: (-x['jaccard'], x['name']))[:5]

        # Mean latent vector for the cluster
        mean_latent = emb_std[idx_in, :].mean(axis=0).astype(float).tolist()

        summary[str(c)] = {
            'size': size_c,
            'domain_counts': dom_counts,
            'protocol_counts': prot_counts,
            'top_sets': top_sets,
            'top_degs': top_degs,
            'marker_overlap': marker_overlaps,
            'mean_latent': mean_latent
        }

    with open(out_cluster_summary, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(summary, f, indent=2)
    # Assert summary exists and is JSON dict
    assert os.path.exists(out_cluster_summary)
    with open(out_cluster_summary, 'r') as f:
        schk = json.load(f)
    assert isinstance(schk, dict) and len(schk) >= 1

    # UMAP and plot
    sc.tl.umap(ad_latent, min_dist=0.3)
    coords = ad_latent.obsm['X_umap']
    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
    # Color map per cluster
    clusters = ad_latent.obs[best_key].astype(str).values
    uniq = np.unique(clusters)
    # Assign colors
    cmap = plt.get_cmap('tab20')
    color_map = {cl: cmap(i % 20) for i, cl in enumerate(uniq)}
    colors = [color_map[c] for c in clusters]
    plt.scatter(coords[:, 0], coords[:, 1], c=colors, s=5, linewidths=0, alpha=0.9)
    plt.axis('off')
    plt.title('UMAP of latent - Leiden clusters')
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(out_umap_plot, dpi=150)
    plt.close()
    # Assert PNG exists and non-empty
    assert os.path.exists(out_umap_plot) and os.path.getsize(out_umap_plot) > 0

def ensure_dir(p: str):
    if not os.path.isdir(p):
        os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)


def canonicalize_symbol(x: str) -> str:
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ""
    s = str(x).strip()
    # Remove version suffix after '.', keep main part (e.g., AL627309.1 -> AL627309)
    s = s.split(".")[0]
    s = s.replace(" ", "").replace("-", "").upper()
    return s


def split_genes_field(s: str) -> List[str]:
    if pd.isna(s):
        return []
    # Split on commas, semicolons, pipes, tabs, or whitespace
    parts = re.split(r"[,\;\|\t\s]+", str(s))
    parts = [canonicalize_symbol(p) for p in parts if canonicalize_symbol(p) != ""]
    return parts


def load_anndata_gene_vocab(h5ad_path: str) -> Tuple[int, List[str]]:
    adata = ad.read_h5ad(h5ad_path)
    var_names = [str(g) for g in adata.var_names]
    n_genes = len(var_names)
    return n_genes, var_names


def build_symbol_mapping(meta_csv: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    # Build mapping from various gene strings to canonical summary_symbol
    df = pd.read_csv(meta_csv)
    mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if "summary_symbol" in df.columns:
        for _, r in df.iterrows():
            sym = canonicalize_symbol(r.get("summary_symbol", ""))
            if sym == "":

            # Map the 'gene' column to summary_symbol if present
            g = canonicalize_symbol(r.get("gene", ""))
            if g != "":

            # Also map the summary_symbol to itself (idempotent)

        elif "cellular component" in desc:

def parse_cellmarker(xlsx_path: str, sym2idx: Dict[str, int]) -> List[SetRecord]:
    recs: List[SetRecord] = []
    if not os.path.isfile(xlsx_path):
        return recs
    df = pd.read_excel(xlsx_path)
    # Prefer 'Symbol' if populated; else use 'marker'
    # Group by cell_type
    if "cell_type" not in df.columns:
        return recs
    # Prepare gene lists per row
    def row_genes(row) -> List[str]:
        if "Symbol" in row and isinstance(row["Symbol"], str) and row["Symbol"].strip() != "":
            return split_genes_field(row["Symbol"])
        if "marker" in row and isinstance(row["marker"], str):
            return split_genes_field(row["marker"])
        return []
    df["_genes_list"] = df.apply(row_genes, axis=1)
    # Group by cell_type and aggregate unions
    for cell_type, sub in df.groupby("cell_type"):
        genes_flat: List[str] = []
        for lst in sub["_genes_list"]:
            genes_flat.extend(lst)
        genes_set = set(g for g in genes_flat if g in sym2idx)
        if len(genes_set) == 0:
            continue
        idxs = set(sym2idx[g] for g in genes_set)
        name = f"Marker_{str(cell_type)}"
        recs.append(SetRecord(name=name, source="CellMarker", category="marker", genes=idxs))
    return recs


def deduplicate_sets_greedy(sets: List[SetRecord], jaccard_thresh: float = 0.95) -> List[SetRecord]:
    kept: List[SetRecord] = []
    for rec in sets:
        if len(rec.genes) == 0:
            continue
        keep = True
        for k in kept:
            inter = len(rec.genes & k.genes)
            if inter == 0:
                continue
            union = len(rec.genes) + len(k.genes) - inter
            jac = inter / union if union > 0 else 0.0
            if jac >= jaccard_thresh and rec.category == k.category and rec.source == k.source:
                keep = False
                break
        if keep:
            kept.append(rec)
    return kept


def filter_by_size(sets: List[SetRecord], min_size: int, max_size: int) -> List[SetRecord]:
    out: List[SetRecord] = []
    for r in sets:
        sz = len(r.genes)
        if sz >= min_size and sz <= max_size:
            out.append(r)
    return out


def build_S_and_meta(sets: List[SetRecord], n_genes: int, banned: Set[int]) -> Tuple[csr_matrix, pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, Set[int]]:
    rows = []
    cols = []
    data = []
    meta_rows = []
    nsets_kept = 0
    gene_set_count = np.zeros(n_genes, dtype=np.int64)
    marker_genes: Set[int] = set()

    final_sets: List[SetRecord] = []
    for r in sets:
        # Exclude banned genes from set
        member = [g for g in r.genes if g not in banned]
        if r.category == "marker":
            for g in member:
                marker_genes.add(g)
        if r.category == "marker":
            min_sz = 5
        else:
            min_sz = 10
        if len(member) < min_sz:
            continue
        final_sets.append(SetRecord(name=r.name, source=r.source, category=r.category, genes=set(member)))

    for set_id, r in enumerate(final_sets):
        sz = len(r.genes)
        weight = 1.0 / np.sqrt(sz) if sz > 0 else 0.0
        # Row-normalization target: sum to 1 => per-entry value = 1/sz
        val = 1.0 / sz
        for g in r.genes:
            rows.append(set_id)
            cols.append(g)
            data.append(val)
            gene_set_count[g] += 1
        meta_rows.append({
            "set_id": set_id,
            "name": r.name,
            "source": r.source,
            "category": r.category,
            "size": sz,
            "weight": weight
        })
        nsets_kept += 1

    if len(rows) == 0:
        S = csr_matrix((0, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    else:
        S = csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                       shape=(nsets_kept, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_rows, columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    return S, meta_df, gene_set_count, marker_genes


def compute_jaccard_topk(B_bin: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    # B_bin: (n_sets x n_genes) binary CSR matrix
    n_sets, n_genes = B_bin.shape
    if n_sets == 0 or n_genes == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    # Compute co-membership counts C = B^T * B (n_genes x n_genes)
    C = (B_bin.T).dot(B_bin).tocsr()
    deg = np.asarray(B_bin.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)  # number of sets per gene

    # Zero out diagonal by subtracting deg on diagonal
    diag_idx = np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int32)
    C = C.tolil(copy=True)
    C[diag_idx, diag_idx] = 0
    C = C.tocsr()

    indptr = C.indptr
    indices = C.indices
    data = C.data

    rows_out = []
    cols_out = []
    vals_out = []

    for i in range(n_genes):
        start = indptr[i]
        end = indptr[i + 1]
        js = indices[start:end]
        co = data[start:end].astype(np.float32)
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        denom = deg[i] + deg[js] - co
        # Avoid divide by zero
        denom = np.where(denom <= 0, 1.0, denom)
        jacc = co / denom
        # Select top-k neighbors
        if jacc.size > k:
            topk_idx = np.argpartition(-jacc, k)[:k]
            js_top = js[topk_idx]
            jacc_top = jacc[topk_idx]
            # sort by value descending for stability
            order = np.argsort(-jacc_top)
            js_top = js_top[order]
            jacc_top = jacc_top[order]
        else:
            js_top = js
            jacc_top = jacc
        # Store
        rows_out.extend([i] * len(js_top))
        cols_out.extend(js_top.tolist())
        vals_out.extend(jacc_top.tolist())

    if len(rows_out) == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    A = csr_matrix((np.array(vals_out, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows_out, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols_out, dtype=np.int32))),
                   shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
    return A


def symmetrize_max(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    return (A.maximum(A.T)).tocsr()


def row_normalize_csr(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr(copy=True)
    row_sums = np.asarray(A.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    nz = row_sums > 0
    inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz]
    Dinv = sparse.diags(inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    return Dinv.dot(A).astype(np.float32)


def keep_topk_per_row(A: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr()
    n_rows = A.shape[0]
    rows = []
    cols = []
    data = []
    for i in range(n_rows):
        start = A.indptr[i]
        end = A.indptr[i + 1]
        js = A.indices[start:end]
        vals = A.data[start:end]
        # Remove self-loop if present
        mask = js != i
        js = js[mask]
        vals = vals[mask]
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        if js.size > k:
            idx = np.argpartition(-vals, k)[:k]
            js_k = js[idx]
            vals_k = vals[idx]
            order = np.argsort(-vals_k)
            js_k = js_k[order]
            vals_k = vals_k[order]
        else:
            js_k = js
            vals_k = vals
        rows.extend([i] * js_k.size)
        cols.extend(js_k.tolist())
        data.extend(vals_k.tolist())
    if len(rows) == 0:
        return csr_matrix(A.shape, dtype=np.float32)
    return csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                      shape=A.shape, dtype=np.float32)


def main():
    ensure_dir(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR)

    # Load dataset genes
    n_genes, var_names = load_anndata_gene_vocab(INPUT_MOD1)

        else:

            t = meta_df.loc[meta_df["summary_symbol"].apply(canonicalize_symbol) == s, "summary_type"]
            if t.shape[0] > 0:
                any_pseudo = any(("pseudogene" in str(tt).lower()) for tt in t.values)
                if any_pseudo:
                    banned.add(i)

        # MT genes, ribosomal pseudogenes already covered by above condition, but also ban MT- and RPL/RPS pseudogenes heuristically
        if s.startswith("MT"):

    tmp_S, tmp_meta, gene_set_count_tmp, marker_genes_tmp = build_S_and_meta(all_sets, n_genes, banned=set())
    n_sets_tmp = tmp_S.shape[0]
    # Determine overly-ubiquitous genes: in >20% of sets
    overly_ubiq = set(np.where(gene_set_count_tmp > 0.2 * max(n_sets_tmp, 1))[0].tolist()) if n_sets_tmp > 0 else set()
    # Extend banned with overly ubiquitous and explicit ribosomal (to down-weight) but we do not necessarily ban all ribosomal, follow blacklist rule for pseudogenes/ribosomal pseudogenes.
    banned = banned.union(overly_ubiq)

    S, set_meta_df, gene_set_count, marker_genes = build_S_and_meta(all_sets, n_genes, banned=banned)

    save_npz(SET_INCIDENCE_NPZ, S.astype(np.float32))
    assert os.path.isfile(SET_INCIDENCE_NPZ), "set_incidence.npz not written."
    S_loaded = load_npz(SET_INCIDENCE_NPZ)
    assert sparse.isspmatrix_csr(S_loaded), "set_incidence must be CSR format."
    assert S_loaded.dtype == np.float32, "set_incidence must be float32."

    nest_sets = []
    if os.path.isfile(NEST_TSV):

        for _, r in df_nest.iterrows():

    assert A_loaded.dtype == np.float32, "gene_gene_adj must be float32."
    assert A_loaded.shape == (n_genes, n_genes), f"gene_gene_adj shape mismatch: {A_loaded.shape} vs ({n_genes},{n_genes})"

    # Gene prior weights
    weights = np.ones(n_genes, dtype=np.float32)
    qc_flag = (is_mito | is_ribo | is_housekeeping)
    # Ubiquity penalty: genes in >20% sets
    frac_in_sets = np.zeros(n_genes, dtype=np.float32)
    if n_sets > 0:
        frac_in_sets = gene_set_count.astype(np.float32) / float(n_sets)
    ubiq_mask = frac_in_sets > 0.2

    for i in range(n_genes):
        if qc_flag[i]:
            weights[i] = 0.1
            continue
        # Start at 1.0 and reduce by ubiquity
        if ubiq_mask[i]:
            weights[i] = 0.5

        # Count small sets (<=50) participation
        small_count = 0
        # Estimate small set participation by scanning S row sizes via set_meta_df
        # Faster: derive from S: rows where S[r,i] > 0 and set_meta_df.size[r] <= 50
        if n_sets > 0:

        inc_marker = 0.2 if i in marker_genes else 0.0

    banned_syms = []

    assert os.path.isfile(BANNED_GENES_TXT), "banned_genes.txt not written."
    # Gene vocab CSV
    keep_flag = np.array([False if i in banned else True for i in range(n_genes)], dtype=bool)
    gene_vocab_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "gene_raw": var_names,
        "symbol": mapped_symbols,
        "gene_index": np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int64),
        "keep_flag": keep_flag.astype(bool),
        "is_mito": is_mito.astype(bool),
        "is_ribo": is_ribo.astype(bool),
        "is_lncRNA": is_lnc.astype(bool),
        "is_housekeeping": is_housekeeping.astype(bool)
    })
    gene_vocab_df.to_csv(GENE_VOCAB_CSV, index=False)
    assert os.path.isfile(GENE_VOCAB_CSV), "gene_vocab.csv not written."
    gv_check = pd.read_csv(GENE_VOCAB_CSV)
    for col in ["gene_raw", "symbol", "gene_index", "keep_flag", "is_mito", "is_ribo", "is_lncRNA", "is_housekeeping"]:
        assert col in gv_check.columns, f"Missing column in gene_vocab: {col}"
    assert gv_check.shape[0] == n_genes, "gene_vocab rows mismatch with number of genes."

    # Gene prior weights CSV
    gpw_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "gene_index": np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int64),
        "symbol": mapped_symbols,
        "weight": weights.astype(np.float32)

    assert gw_check.shape[0] == n_genes, "gene_prior_weights rows mismatch with number of genes."

    assert np.all(wvals >= 0.0) and np.all(wvals <= 1.0), "Gene prior weights must be in [0,1]."

    # Final assertions: cross-consistency shapes
    # set_incidence cols == n_genes already checked; set_meta rows == set_inc rows
    # gene_gene_adj shape checked; gene_vocab and gene_weights rows == n_genes
    # banned_genes file exists

    print(f"- Sets retained: {n_sets}")
    print(f"- Banned genes: {len(banned_syms)}")

Part 2 — Model Architecture and Training (model_training.py)
- Overview: Prior-guided pathway graph autoencoder with masked genes→sets layer, domain-alignment (MMD), marker anchoring, and clustering refinement.
- Architecture
  - Input: n_genes_final features (scaled log1p), optionally weighted by per-gene w_gene during loss.
  - Layer 1 (Genes→Sets):
    - Masked linear W_gs initialized to S; non-edges fixed at 0; edges trainable scaling.
    - Bias per set; activation ReLU; dropout 0.1; LayerNorm on set activations.
  - Layer 2 (Sets→Latent):
    - Dense 512 → 128 → Latent d=32 (ReLU, dropout 0.1, LayerNorm).
    - Reserve d_marker dims (e.g., 16) as marker-anchored subspace.
  - Decoder:
    - Latent → 128 → 512 → Sets → Genes; tie Sets→Genes weights to W_gs^T mask; reconstruct scaled log1p.
  - Optional batch covariate encoder:
    - Feed domain/protocol as one-hot to a nuisance head for correlation penalty (no gradients to inputs).
- Losses (combined)
  - Reconstruction: MSE between reconstructed and input (per-gene weighted by w_gene; ignore banned genes).
  - Prior proximity: L2 on (W_gs − S) over masked edges.
  - Group sparsity: Group Lasso on columns of W_gs (encourage a gene connects to few sets).
  - Graph Laplacian: tr(W_gs L_A W_gs^T) using A from gene_gene_adj.npz.
  - Marker anchoring:
    - Correlate reserved latent dims with per-cell marker activity proxies (mean of marker genes per set); MSE/correlation loss with stronger weight for marker sets; no labels used.
  - Batch alignment: MMD on latent across domains; kernel bandwidth median heuristic.
  - Nuisance penalty: Reduce Pearson correlation between latent dims and {percent.mt, nCount_RNA}.
  - Clustering refinement (after warmup):
    - DEC: k-means init on latent (k from Leiden on latent at resolution sweep, unsupervised choice via silhouette); Student-t soft assignments; KL divergence to target distribution.
- Hyperparameters (defaults)
  - d_latent=32, d_marker=16; dropout=0.1; batch size=512; epochs=200.
  - Optimizer: AdamW lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-4; grad clip=5.0; cosine annealing or ReduceLROnPlateau (patience=10).
  - Loss weights: λ_recon=1.0, λ_prior=1.0, λ_group=1e-3, λ_lap=1e-2, λ_marker=0.5, λ_mmd=0.2, λ_nuis=0.1, λ_dec=0.5. Tune on val.
- Training schedule
  - Warm-start (epochs 1–30): freeze W_gs to S (no updates), train encoder/decoder with recon only.
  - Structured fine-tune (epochs 31–60): unfreeze W_gs edges; enable λ_prior, λ_group, λ_lap, λ_marker; start λ_mmd, λ_nuis at half strength.
  - Clustering phase (epochs 61–200): enable DEC; refresh target distribution every 5 epochs; anneal λ_mmd to full by epoch 100.
  - Early stopping: monitor val objective (recon + λ_mmd + λ_marker), patience=20; restore best.
- Checkpoints and exports
  - /runsv3/model/checkpoints/best.pt
  - /runsv3/model/latent_{train|val|test}.npy (cells×d)
  - /runsv3/model/set_activity_{train|val|test}.npy (cells×n_sets) and set_meta copy

def ensure_dir(p: str):
    if not os.path.isdir(p):
        os.makedirs(p, exist_ok=True)


def canonicalize_symbol(x: str) -> str:
    if pd.isna(x):
        return ""
    s = str(x).strip()
    # Remove version suffix after '.', keep main part (e.g., AL627309.1 -> AL627309)
    s = s.split(".")[0]
    s = s.replace(" ", "").replace("-", "").upper()
    return s


def split_genes_field(s: str) -> List[str]:
    if pd.isna(s):
        return []
    # Split on commas, semicolons, pipes, tabs, or whitespace
    parts = re.split(r"[,\;\|\t\s]+", str(s))
    parts = [canonicalize_symbol(p) for p in parts if canonicalize_symbol(p) != ""]
    return parts


def load_anndata_gene_vocab(h5ad_path: str) -> Tuple[int, List[str]]:
    adata = ad.read_h5ad(h5ad_path)
    var_names = [str(g) for g in adata.var_names]
    n_genes = len(var_names)
    return n_genes, var_names


def build_symbol_mapping(meta_csv: str) -> Dict[str, str]:
    # Build mapping from various gene strings to canonical summary_symbol
    df = pd.read_csv(meta_csv)
    mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if "summary_symbol" in df.columns:
        for _, r in df.iterrows():
            sym = canonicalize_symbol(r.get("summary_symbol", ""))
            if sym == "":
                continue
            # Map the 'gene' column to summary_symbol if present
            g = canonicalize_symbol(r.get("gene", ""))
            if g != "":
                mapping[g] = sym
            # Also map the summary_symbol to itself (idempotent)
            mapping[sym] = sym
    return mapping


def determine_gene_flags(symbols: List[str], meta_df: pd.DataFrame) -> Tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    # Heuristics for gene categories
    is_mito = np.array([sym.startswith("MT") for sym in symbols], dtype=bool)
    is_ribo = np.array([sym.startswith("RPL") or sym.startswith("RPS") for sym in symbols], dtype=bool)
    # lncRNA by symbol prefix or meta_info 'summary_type' if available
    meta_map_type: Dict[str, str] = {}
    if "summary_symbol" in meta_df.columns and "summary_type" in meta_df.columns:
        for _, r in meta_df.iterrows():
            sym = canonicalize_symbol(r.get("summary_symbol", ""))
            t = str(r.get("summary_type", "")).lower()
            if sym != "":
                meta_map_type[sym] = t
    is_lnc = []
    for sym in symbols:
        t = meta_map_type.get(sym, "")
        is_lnc.append(sym.startswith("LINC") or ("lncrna" in t))
    is_lnc = np.array(is_lnc, dtype=bool)
    # Housekeeping: small curated list + ribosomal
    hk_set = set([
        "ACTB", "ACTG1", "GAPDH", "B2M", "RPLP0", "EEF1A1", "TUBB", "TUBA1B", "PPIA", "UBA52", "RPL13A", "HPRT1"
    ])
    is_hk = np.array([(sym in hk_set) or (sym.startswith("EEF")) for sym in symbols], dtype=bool)
    # Combine with ribosomal as housekeeping too (keep separate flag but also mark housekeeping)
    is_housekeeping = np.array(is_hk | is_ribo, dtype=bool)
    return is_mito, is_ribo, is_lnc, is_housekeeping


class SetRecord:
    def __init__(self, name: str, source: str, category: str, genes: Set[int]):
        self.name = name
        self.source = source
        self.category = category
        self.genes = set(genes)  # set of gene indices


def parse_msigdb(msigdb_csv: str, sym2idx: Dict[str, int]) -> List[SetRecord]:
    recs: List[SetRecord] = []
    if not os.path.isfile(msigdb_csv):
        return recs
    df = pd.read_csv(msigdb_csv)
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        name = str(r.get("Name", r.get("ID", "MSigDB_SET")))
        genes = split_genes_field(r.get("Genes", ""))
        idxs = [sym2idx[g] for g in genes if g in sym2idx]
        if len(idxs) == 0:
            continue
        # Category heuristic based on name
        nm = name.upper()
        cat = "BP"
        if nm.startswith("GOMF_"):
            cat = "MF"
        elif nm.startswith("GOCC_"):
            cat = "CC"
        elif nm.startswith("GOBP_"):
            cat = "BP"
        elif nm.startswith("HALLMARK_"):
            cat = "BP"
        elif nm.startswith("REACTOME_") or nm.startswith("KEGG_"):
            cat = "BP"
        recs.append(SetRecord(name=name, source="MSigDB", category=cat, genes=set(idxs)))
    return recs


def parse_go(go_csv: str, sym2idx: Dict[str, int]) -> List[SetRecord]:
    recs: List[SetRecord] = []
    if not os.path.isfile(go_csv):
        return recs
    df = pd.read_csv(go_csv)
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        name = str(r.get("Term_Description", r.get("GO", "GO_SET")))
        genes = split_genes_field(r.get("Genes", ""))
        idxs = [sym2idx[g] for g in genes if g in sym2idx]
        if len(idxs) == 0:
            continue
        # Attempt to parse category from GO term description if present
        cat = "BP"
        desc = str(r.get("Term_Description", "")).lower()
        if "molecular function" in desc:
            cat = "MF"
        elif "cellular component" in desc:
            cat = "CC"
        elif "biological process" in desc:
            cat = "BP"
        recs.append(SetRecord(name=name, source="GO", category=cat, genes=set(idxs)))
    return recs


def parse_cellmarker(xlsx_path: str, sym2idx: Dict[str, int]) -> List[SetRecord]:
    recs: List[SetRecord] = []
    if not os.path.isfile(xlsx_path):
        return recs
    df = pd.read_excel(xlsx_path)
    # Prefer 'Symbol' if populated; else use 'marker'
    # Group by cell_type
    if "cell_type" not in df.columns:
        return recs
    # Prepare gene lists per row
    def row_genes(row) -> List[str]:
        if "Symbol" in row and isinstance(row["Symbol"], str) and row["Symbol"].strip() != "":
            return split_genes_field(row["Symbol"])
        if "marker" in row and isinstance(row["marker"], str):
            return split_genes_field(row["marker"])
        return []
    df["_genes_list"] = df.apply(row_genes, axis=1)
    # Group by cell_type and aggregate unions
    for cell_type, sub in df.groupby("cell_type"):
        genes_flat: List[str] = []
        for lst in sub["_genes_list"]:
            genes_flat.extend(lst)
        genes_set = set(g for g in genes_flat if g in sym2idx)
        if len(genes_set) == 0:
            continue
        idxs = set(sym2idx[g] for g in genes_set)
        name = f"Marker_{str(cell_type)}"
        recs.append(SetRecord(name=name, source="CellMarker", category="marker", genes=idxs))
    return recs


def deduplicate_sets_greedy(sets: List[SetRecord], jaccard_thresh: float = 0.95) -> List[SetRecord]:
    kept: List[SetRecord] = []
    for rec in sets:
        if len(rec.genes) == 0:
            continue
        keep = True
        for k in kept:
            inter = len(rec.genes & k.genes)
            if inter == 0:
                continue
            union = len(rec.genes) + len(k.genes) - inter
            jac = inter / union if union > 0 else 0.0
            if jac >= jaccard_thresh and rec.category == k.category and rec.source == k.source:
                keep = False
                break
        if keep:
            kept.append(rec)
    return kept


def filter_by_size(sets: List[SetRecord], min_size: int, max_size: int) -> List[SetRecord]:
    out: List[SetRecord] = []
    for r in sets:
        sz = len(r.genes)
        if sz >= min_size and sz <= max_size:
            out.append(r)
    return out


def build_S_and_meta(sets: List[SetRecord], n_genes: int, banned: Set[int]) -> Tuple[csr_matrix, pd.DataFrame, np.ndarray, Set[int]]:
    rows = []
    cols = []
    data = []
    meta_rows = []
    nsets_kept = 0
    gene_set_count = np.zeros(n_genes, dtype=np.int64)
    marker_genes: Set[int] = set()

    final_sets: List[SetRecord] = []
    for r in sets:
        # Exclude banned genes from set
        member = [g for g in r.genes if g not in banned]
        if r.category == "marker":
            for g in member:
                marker_genes.add(g)
        if r.category == "marker":
            min_sz = 5
        else:
            min_sz = 10
        if len(member) < min_sz:
            continue
        final_sets.append(SetRecord(name=r.name, source=r.source, category=r.category, genes=set(member)))

    for set_id, r in enumerate(final_sets):
        sz = len(r.genes)
        weight = 1.0 / np.sqrt(sz) if sz > 0 else 0.0
        # Row-normalization target: sum to 1 => per-entry value = 1/sz
        val = 1.0 / sz
        for g in r.genes:
            rows.append(set_id)
            cols.append(g)
            data.append(val)
            gene_set_count[g] += 1
        meta_rows.append({
            "set_id": set_id,
            "name": r.name,
            "source": r.source,
            "category": r.category,
            "size": sz,
            "weight": weight
        })
        nsets_kept += 1

    if len(rows) == 0:
        S = csr_matrix((0, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    else:
        S = csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                       shape=(nsets_kept, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
        meta_df = pd.DataFrame(meta_rows, columns=["set_id", "name", "source", "category", "size", "weight"])
    return S, meta_df, gene_set_count, marker_genes


def compute_jaccard_topk(B_bin: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    # B_bin: (n_sets x n_genes) binary CSR matrix
    n_sets, n_genes = B_bin.shape
    if n_sets == 0 or n_genes == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    # Compute co-membership counts C = B^T * B (n_genes x n_genes)
    C = (B_bin.T).dot(B_bin).tocsr()
    deg = np.asarray(B_bin.sum(axis=0)).ravel().astype(np.float32)  # number of sets per gene

    # Zero out diagonal by subtracting deg on diagonal
    diag_idx = np.arange(n_genes, dtype=np.int32)
    C = C.tolil(copy=True)
    C[diag_idx, diag_idx] = 0
    C = C.tocsr()

    indptr = C.indptr
    indices = C.indices
    data = C.data

    rows_out = []
    cols_out = []
    vals_out = []

    for i in range(n_genes):
        start = indptr[i]
        end = indptr[i + 1]
        js = indices[start:end]
        co = data[start:end].astype(np.float32)
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        denom = deg[i] + deg[js] - co
        # Avoid divide by zero
        denom = np.where(denom <= 0, 1.0, denom)
        jacc = co / denom
        # Select top-k neighbors
        if jacc.size > k:
            topk_idx = np.argpartition(-jacc, k)[:k]
            js_top = js[topk_idx]
            jacc_top = jacc[topk_idx]
            # sort by value descending for stability
            order = np.argsort(-jacc_top)
            js_top = js_top[order]
            jacc_top = jacc_top[order]
        else:
            js_top = js
            jacc_top = jacc
        # Store
        rows_out.extend([i] * len(js_top))
        cols_out.extend(js_top.tolist())
        vals_out.extend(jacc_top.tolist())

    if len(rows_out) == 0:
        return csr_matrix((n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)

    A = csr_matrix((np.array(vals_out, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows_out, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols_out, dtype=np.int32))),
                   shape=(n_genes, n_genes), dtype=np.float32)
    return A


def symmetrize_max(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    return (A.maximum(A.T)).tocsr()


def row_normalize_csr(A: csr_matrix) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr(copy=True)
    row_sums = np.asarray(A.sum(axis=1)).ravel()
    nz = row_sums > 0
    inv = np.zeros_like(row_sums, dtype=np.float32)
    inv[nz] = 1.0 / row_sums[nz]
    Dinv = sparse.diags(inv, offsets=0, format="csr", dtype=np.float32)
    return Dinv.dot(A).astype(np.float32)


def keep_topk_per_row(A: csr_matrix, k: int = 50) -> csr_matrix:
    A = A.tocsr()
    n_rows = A.shape[0]
    rows = []
    cols = []
    data = []
    for i in range(n_rows):
        start = A.indptr[i]
        end = A.indptr[i + 1]
        js = A.indices[start:end]
        vals = A.data[start:end]
        # Remove self-loop if present
        mask = js != i
        js = js[mask]
        vals = vals[mask]
        if js.size == 0:
            continue
        if js.size > k:
            idx = np.argpartition(-vals, k)[:k]
            js_k = js[idx]
            vals_k = vals[idx]
            order = np.argsort(-vals_k)
            js_k = js_k[order]
            vals_k = vals_k[order]
        else:
            js_k = js
            vals_k = vals
        rows.extend([i] * js_k.size)
        cols.extend(js_k.tolist())
        data.extend(vals_k.tolist())
    if len(rows) == 0:
        return csr_matrix(A.shape, dtype=np.float32)
    return csr_matrix((np.array(data, dtype=np.float32), (np.array(rows, dtype=np.int32), np.array(cols, dtype=np.int32))),
                      shape=A.shape, dtype=np.float32)


def main():
    ensure_dir(PRIOR_OUTPUT_DIR)

    # Load dataset genes
    n_genes, var_names = load_anndata_gene_vocab(INPUT_MOD1)
    assert n_genes > 0, "No genes found in input AnnData."
    # Build symbol mapping
    meta_df = pd.read_csv(META_INFO_CSV)
    sym_map = build_symbol_mapping(META_INFO_CSV)

    # Harmonize dataset gene symbols
    raw_symbols = [canonicalize_symbol(g) for g in var_names]
    mapped_symbols = []
    for s in raw_symbols:
        if s in sym_map:
            mapped_symbols.append(sym_map[s])
        else:
            mapped_symbols.append(s)
    # Build symbol to index (keep first occurrence)
    sym2idx: Dict[str, int] = {}
    for i, s in enumerate(mapped_symbols):
        if s != "" and s not in sym2idx:
            sym2idx[s] = i

    is_mito, is_ribo, is_lnc, is_housekeeping = determine_gene_flags(mapped_symbols, meta_df)

    sets_msig = parse_msigdb(MSIGDB_CSV, sym2idx)
    sets_go = parse_go(GO_TERMS_CSV, sym2idx)

    sets_msig = filter_by_size(sets_msig, 10, 500)
    sets_go = filter_by_size(sets_go, 10, 500)
    # Merge sets
    all_sets: List[SetRecord] = sets_msig + sets_go + sets_markers
    # Deduplicate by high Jaccard
    all_sets = deduplicate_sets_greedy(all_sets, jaccard_thresh=0.95)

    # Initial banned genes: QC/blacklist and pseudogenes by meta_info (if any)
    banned: Set[int] = set()
    # Blacklist mitochondrial and ribosomal pseudogenes explicitly
    for i, s in enumerate(mapped_symbols):
        if s == "":
            banned.add(i)
            continue
        # Pseudogene via meta_info summary_type
        if "summary_symbol" in meta_df.columns and "summary_type" in meta_df.columns:
            t = meta_df.loc[meta_df["summary_symbol"].apply(canonicalize_symbol) == s, "summary_type"]
            if t.shape[0] > 0:
                any_pseudo = any(("pseudogene" in str(tt).lower()) for tt in t.values)
                if any_pseudo:
                    banned.add(i)
                    continue
        # MT genes, ribosomal pseudogenes already covered by above condition, but also ban MT- and RPL/RPS pseudogenes heuristically
        if s.startswith("MT"):
            banned.add(i)

    # Build temporary S and gene set counts to identify ubiquity
    # Note: For ubiquity calculation, don't exclude QC banned yet, so we can judge ubiquity accurately among functional sets
    tmp_S, tmp_meta, gene_set_count_tmp, marker_genes_tmp = build_S_and_meta(all_sets, n_genes, banned=set())
    n_sets_tmp = tmp_S.shape[0]
    # Determine overly-ubiquitous genes: in >20% of sets
    overly_ubiq = set(np.where(gene_set_count_tmp > 0.2 * max(n_sets_tmp, 1))[0].tolist()) if n_sets_tmp > 0 else set()
